changes.summary: Keep only the newest browser session for each account in the login account picker.
Rebase multi-digit repository filter placeholders without corrupting their indices.
Keep local E2E database settings from overriding CI service ports.
Expose stable test selectors and raw totals for Lens panels, legends, and tabs.
Collapse secondary accounts and global account actions in the authenticated navbar profile menu.
Paginate the roles list so roles past the first page are reachable.
Load complete, scalable role and group options in user forms and let signed-in users securely change their own password.
Add demand-driven verified SDK releases and sdk-tools consumer preview/promotion commands.
